en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
What a great view...
Let's dance!
Let's go for a walk
Ahhhhhhhhhh!

<CLT=cltMIND>Angie suddenly screamed and began
moving her paintbrush in wild strokes.
Hahhh... Hahhh...

Nyahaha! When you mentioned the view,
I was overcome with divine inspiration!
You can have this picture, Shuichi!

<CLT=cltMIND>Somehow, I ended up holding the picture,
even though I don't remember looking at it.

On my island, only the women are allowed
to dance.

If they dance well, they get money from
all the men who are watching.

Oh, but they gotta take the money with their
mouths. That's the most important part.
Huh? Walking? Just regular walking?

Atua says He doesn't understand what's
so fun about that.

I'll walk to look for offerings, but we're
the only ones here in the first place.
So there's no reason to go for a walk.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
(Hmmm...)
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Angie's inner thoughts...?
